## Specification

### Component: Navigation menu

Site-header menus whose triggers share ONE floating panel. The panel resizes between items, content slides in from the side of travel and a caret glides under the active trigger. Narrow screens get an accordion.

#### Anatomy
```
<NavigationMenu value|defaultValue|onValueChange mode="auto|menu|accordion" collapseBelow openDelay closeDelay>   nav.ui-nav-menu aria-label="Site menu" data-mode
  <NavigationMenuList>                      ul.ui-nav-menu-list (arrow keys between triggers / links)
    <NavigationMenuItem value?>             li.ui-nav-menu-item
      <NavigationMenuTrigger>               button.ui-nav-menu-trigger data-nav-value aria-expanded aria-controls + chevron
      <NavigationMenuContent>               portaled into the shared panel (menu mode) or .ui-nav-menu-accordion (accordion)
        <NavigationMenuLink asChild? active> a.ui-nav-menu-link[data-in-content]
          <NavigationMenuLinkTitle /> <NavigationMenuLinkDescription />
    <NavigationMenuItem><NavigationMenuLink />     plain link in the bar
  (rendered by NavigationMenu in menu mode, when open)
  div.ui-floating.ui-nav-menu-panel[popover=manual][data-state]   top layer, left/top written by JS, --ui-nav-caret-x
    div.ui-nav-menu-surface   border, radius-xl, shadow-lg, overflow hidden — the visible box
      div.ui-nav-menu-slot    position: relative; width: max-content — the content's natural size
        div.ui-nav-menu-content[data-state][data-motion="from-start|from-end|to-start|to-end"]
    span.ui-nav-menu-caret
```
Layout helper class: `.ui-nav-menu-grid` with `--ui-nav-cols` and `--ui-nav-width` (full width, one column in the accordion).

#### Behaviour
- State `value` ('' = closed) is controlled or uncontrolled. Mode `auto`: `menu` at ≥ `collapseBelow` (768) viewport width, `accordion` below. Triggers register their elements in a map.
- Hover (mouse only): entering a trigger opens it after `openDelay` (120ms), or at once if a panel is already open. Leaving the whole nav (the panel is a DOM child, so moving trigger → panel never leaves) closes it after `closeDelay` (240ms); entering cancels. Entering a plain link closes it after 150ms. A click right after a hover-open keeps it open; the next click closes it. Touch: click toggles.
- Keyboard: ←/→ between triggers and links (and switch the open panel); ↓ opens and focuses the first link (or enters an open panel); Enter/Space toggle with focus kept on the trigger; Tab from an open trigger enters the panel; inside, arrows move between links, ↑ from the first returns to the trigger; Esc closes and refocuses the trigger; focus leaving the nav closes it; clicking a link closes it.
- Switching items (menu mode): before the state change capture the surface and caret rects and the direction (`end` if the new trigger is to the right). After render (layout effect): `place()` centres the panel under the new trigger (clamped to 8px of the viewport, 12px below the trigger, caret clamped 20px inside), then animate with WAAPI on `--ui-spring-smooth`: the panel's `translate` from the old to the new position, the surface's `width`/`height` from old to new box, the caret's `translate`. The slot (not the surface) defines the natural size, so animating the surface never feeds back into positioning. Skipped for reduced motion.
- Content: the new item enters with `from-<direction>` (28px, opacity, 2px blur, 380ms `--ui-ease-out`); the old one is lifted out (`position: absolute`) and leaves with `to-<opposite>` (160ms `--ui-ease-in`). On a full close the last content stays while the panel fades.
- Accordion mode: content is rendered in place in a `grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr` region (smooth spring); closed content is `visibility: hidden`. Triggers toggle a single open item.

#### Visual rules
- Bar items: 36px high, 12px padding, 14px/500, `--radius-md`, muted → `--ui-foreground` on hover / open / current; open trigger fill `--ui-accent`; chevron 14px rotates 180° (snappy spring).
- Panel: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-xl`, `--ui-shadow-lg`; content padding 8px. Rich link: padding 10px 12px, `--radius-md`, title 14px/500, description 13px muted, hover `--ui-accent`.
- Caret: 10px rotated square on the panel's top edge with the top-left borders, same fill as the surface.
- Focus ring `0 0 0 3px` of `--ui-ring` at 45%.

#### Motion
- First open: `ui-pop-in` 380ms from the caret (`--ui-origin`), exit `ui-pop-out` 160ms. Everything else as above.

#### Accessibility
- Disclosure-navigation pattern: nav landmark, buttons with `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`, links in the panel. The panel is in the top layer.

#### Acceptance checks
- Hover opens after a delay, a second trigger switches without closing, leaving closes.
- The panel's box equals the open content's box after the glide; the caret stays under the active trigger and inside the panel.
- ↓ moves focus into the panel, Esc returns it to the trigger, Tab out closes it.
- At 390px (or `mode="accordion"`) triggers expand their links in place and only one is open.

### `ui/components/navigation-menu/navigation-menu-context.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { createContext, useContext, type MutableRefObject } from 'react';

export type NavigationMenuMode = 'menu' | 'accordion';
/** Which side the new content comes from when moving between triggers. */
export type NavigationMenuDirection = 'start' | 'end' | null;

export interface NavigationMenuContextValue {
  /** The open item's value, or '' when closed. */
  value: string;
  /** The last non-empty value (the content that stays visible while the panel fades out). */
  lastValue: string;
  mode: NavigationMenuMode;
  /** Element the open item's content is portaled into (menu mode). */
  slot: HTMLElement | null;
  direction: NavigationMenuDirection;
  triggers: MutableRefObject<Map<string, HTMLElement>>;
  /** Set before opening from the keyboard: the content moves focus to its first link once mounted. */
  focusOnOpen: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  /** The open state came from hovering (a click right after must not close it). */
  hoverOpened: MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  select: (value: string, how: 'hover' | 'click' | 'keyboard') => void;
  close: () => void;
  focusContent: () => void;
  hoverIn: (value: string) => void;
  hoverElsewhere: () => void;
}

export const NavigationMenuContext = createContext<NavigationMenuContextValue | null>(null);

export function useNavigationMenu(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(NavigationMenuContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <NavigationMenu>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface NavigationMenuItemContextValue {
  value: string;
  triggerId: string;
  contentId: string;
}

export const NavigationMenuItemContext = createContext<NavigationMenuItemContextValue | null>(null);

export function useNavigationMenuItem(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(NavigationMenuItemContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <NavigationMenuItem>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/** True for links rendered inside a content panel (rich links, not the top-level bar links). */
export const NavigationMenuInContentContext = createContext(false);

/** Elements the keyboard can land on inside a panel. */
export const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href], button:not(:disabled), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
```

### `ui/components/navigation-menu/navigation-menu-parts.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type AnchorHTMLAttributes,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type LiHTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
} from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import {
  FOCUSABLE,
  NavigationMenuInContentContext,
  NavigationMenuItemContext,
  useNavigationMenu,
  useNavigationMenuItem,
} from './navigation-menu-context';

/** The row of triggers and links. Left / Right (Up / Down in the accordion) move between them. */
export const NavigationMenuList = forwardRef<HTMLUListElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement>>(
  function NavigationMenuList({ className, onKeyDown, ...props }, ref) {
    const ctx = useNavigationMenu('NavigationMenuList');
    const { mode, value, select, close } = ctx;
    const rove = useRovingFocus({
      itemSelector: '.ui-nav-menu-trigger, .ui-nav-menu-link:not([data-in-content])',
      orientation: mode === 'menu' ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical',
      typeahead: false,
      onMove: (item) => {
        // While a panel is open, moving along the bar switches it (or closes it on a plain link)
        if (mode !== 'menu' || !value) return;
        const next = item.getAttribute('data-nav-value');
        if (next) select(next, 'keyboard');
        else close();
      },
    });
    return (
      <ul
        ref={ref}
        data-orientation={mode === 'menu' ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical'}
        className={cn('ui-nav-menu-list', className)}
        onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLUListElement>) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented) rove(e);
        }}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);

export interface NavigationMenuItemProps extends LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> {
  /** Identifies the item (which one is open). Defaults to a generated id. */
  value?: string;
}

/** One entry: either a trigger with content, or a plain link. */
export const NavigationMenuItem = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, NavigationMenuItemProps>(function NavigationMenuItem(
  { value: valueProp, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const auto = useId();
  const value = valueProp ?? auto;
  const ctx = useMemo(
    () => ({ value, triggerId: `${auto}-trigger`, contentId: `${auto}-content` }),
    [value, auto],
  );
  return (
    <NavigationMenuItemContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <li ref={ref} className={cn('ui-nav-menu-item', className)} {...props} />
    </NavigationMenuItemContext.Provider>
  );
});

/**
 * The button that opens an item's panel: hover (with intent delay), click, or
 * Down arrow. Enter / Space toggle it; Down or Tab moves into the panel.
 */
export const NavigationMenuTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>(
  function NavigationMenuTrigger(
    { className, children, onClick, onKeyDown, onPointerEnter, ...props },
    forwardedRef,
  ) {
    const ctx = useNavigationMenu('NavigationMenuTrigger');
    const item = useNavigationMenuItem('NavigationMenuTrigger');
    const elRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
    const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, elRef);
    const open = ctx.value === item.value;
    const { triggers } = ctx;

    useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
      const el = elRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      triggers.current.set(item.value, el);
      return () => {
        triggers.current.delete(item.value);
      };
    }, [item.value, triggers]);

    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        id={item.triggerId}
        type="button"
        data-nav-value={item.value}
        data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={ctx.mode === 'accordion' || open ? item.contentId : undefined}
        className={cn('ui-nav-menu-trigger', className)}
        onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
          onPointerEnter?.(e);
          if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') ctx.hoverIn(item.value);
        }}
        onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
          onClick?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
          if (ctx.mode === 'accordion') {
            ctx.select(open ? '' : item.value, 'click');
          } else if (open) {
            // A click right after hovering it open keeps it open; the next click closes
            if (ctx.hoverOpened.current) ctx.hoverOpened.current = false;
            else ctx.close();
          } else {
            ctx.select(item.value, 'click');
          }
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (e.defaultPrevented || ctx.mode !== 'menu') return;
          if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (open) ctx.focusContent();
            else {
              ctx.focusOnOpen.current = true;
              ctx.select(item.value, 'keyboard');
            }
          } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && !e.shiftKey && open) {
            e.preventDefault();
            ctx.focusContent();
          }
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        <Icon name="chevron-down" size={14} className="ui-nav-menu-chevron" />
      </button>
    );
  },
);

/**
 * The panel content of an item. In menu mode it is portaled into the shared
 * floating panel (so the panel resizes between items and the content slides
 * in from the side of travel); in accordion mode it expands in place.
 */
export const NavigationMenuContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(
  function NavigationMenuContent({ className, children, ...props }, forwardedRef) {
    const ctx = useNavigationMenu('NavigationMenuContent');
    const item = useNavigationMenuItem('NavigationMenuContent');
    const open = ctx.value === item.value;
    // On a full close the last content stays while the panel fades out
    const keep = ctx.value === '' ? ctx.lastValue === item.value : open;
    const { mounted, ref: presenceRef } = usePresence<HTMLDivElement>(keep);
    const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, presenceRef);
    const { focusOnOpen, slot, mode } = ctx;

    // Opened with the keyboard: move focus to the first link once the content is in
    useEffect(() => {
      if (mode !== 'menu' || !open || !mounted || !slot || !focusOnOpen.current) return;
      focusOnOpen.current = false;
      presenceRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)?.focus();
    }, [mode, open, mounted, slot, focusOnOpen, presenceRef]);

    if (mode === 'accordion') {
      return (
        <div
          id={item.contentId}
          data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
          className="ui-nav-menu-accordion"
        >
          <div className="ui-nav-menu-accordion-inner">
            <NavigationMenuInContentContext.Provider value>
              <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-nav-menu-content', className)} {...props}>
                {children}
              </div>
            </NavigationMenuInContentContext.Provider>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (!slot || !mounted) return null;
    const motion = ctx.direction
      ? open
        ? `from-${ctx.direction}`
        : `to-${ctx.direction === 'end' ? 'start' : 'end'}`
      : undefined;
    return createPortal(
      <NavigationMenuInContentContext.Provider value>
        <div
          ref={ref}
          id={item.contentId}
          data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
          data-motion={motion}
          className={cn('ui-nav-menu-content', className)}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </NavigationMenuInContentContext.Provider>,
      slot,
    );
  },
);

export interface NavigationMenuLinkProps extends AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> {
  /** The current page: `aria-current="page"`. */
  active?: boolean;
  /** Render the child element (e.g. a Next.js `<Link>`). */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

/** A link, in the bar or inside a panel. Following one closes the panel. */
export const NavigationMenuLink = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, NavigationMenuLinkProps>(function NavigationMenuLink(
  { active, asChild, className, onClick, onPointerEnter, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useNavigationMenu('NavigationMenuLink');
  const inContent = useContext(NavigationMenuInContentContext);
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'a';
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={ref as never}
      data-in-content={inContent ? '' : undefined}
      data-active={active ? '' : undefined}
      aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-nav-menu-link', className)}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (ctx.mode === 'menu') ctx.close();
      }}
      onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
        onPointerEnter?.(e);
        // Moving from an open trigger onto a plain link lets the panel go
        if (!inContent && e.pointerType === 'mouse') ctx.hoverElsewhere();
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/** Bold first line of a rich panel link. */
export const NavigationMenuLinkTitle = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(
  function NavigationMenuLinkTitle({ className, ...props }, ref) {
    return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-nav-menu-link-title', className)} {...props} />;
  },
);

/** Muted supporting line of a rich panel link. */
export const NavigationMenuLinkDescription = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(
  function NavigationMenuLinkDescription({ className, ...props }, ref) {
    return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-nav-menu-link-description', className)} {...props} />;
  },
);
```

### `ui/components/navigation-menu/navigation-menu.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type FocusEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../../lib/dom';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { useHoverIntent } from '../../hooks/use-hover-intent';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import {
  FOCUSABLE,
  NavigationMenuContext,
  type NavigationMenuContextValue,
  type NavigationMenuDirection,
  type NavigationMenuMode,
} from './navigation-menu-context';

const supportsPopover = typeof HTMLElement !== 'undefined' && 'showPopover' in HTMLElement.prototype;

/** Where the shared panel's surface and caret were (viewport px), for the glide between items. */
interface Geometry {
  left: number;
  top: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  caretX: number;
}

const cssVar = (name: string) => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();

export interface NavigationMenuProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  /** The open item's `value`, or '' for none. */
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /**
   * `auto` (default) is a floating panel on wide viewports and an accordion on
   * narrow ones (below `collapseBelow`). Force one with `menu` or `accordion`
   * (e.g. `accordion` when the menu lives inside the mobile Sheet).
   */
  mode?: 'auto' | NavigationMenuMode;
  /** Viewport width (px) under which `auto` switches to the accordion. Default 768. */
  collapseBelow?: number;
  /** Hover intent: ms before a trigger opens its panel. Default 120. */
  openDelay?: number;
  /** ms before the panel closes after the pointer leaves it. Default 240. */
  closeDelay?: number;
}

/**
 * NavigationMenu — site header menus that share ONE floating panel. The panel
 * resizes to the open item, the content slides in from the side of travel and
 * a caret glides under the active trigger. On narrow screens it is an accordion.
 */
export const NavigationMenu = forwardRef<HTMLElement, NavigationMenuProps>(function NavigationMenu(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue = '',
    onValueChange,
    mode: modeProp = 'auto',
    collapseBelow = 768,
    openDelay = 120,
    closeDelay = 240,
    className,
    children,
    onBlur,
    onPointerEnter,
    onPointerLeave,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, rootRef);
  const surfaceRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const caretRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const slotRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const triggers = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLElement>());
  const focusOnOpen = useRef(false);
  const hoverOpened = useRef(false);
  const from = useRef<Geometry | null>(null);
  const animations = useRef<Animation[]>([]);
  const intent = useHoverIntent();
  const [slot, setSlot] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<NavigationMenuDirection>(null);
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(false);

  const lastValue = useRef('');
  if (value) lastValue.current = value;
  const valueRef = useRef(value);
  valueRef.current = value;

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (modeProp !== 'auto') return;
    const mq = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${collapseBelow - 1}px)`);
    const read = () => setNarrow(mq.matches);
    read();
    mq.addEventListener('change', read);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', read);
  }, [modeProp, collapseBelow]);
  const mode: NavigationMenuMode = modeProp === 'auto' ? (narrow ? 'accordion' : 'menu') : modeProp;
  const modeRef = useRef(mode);
  modeRef.current = mode;

  const open = value !== '' && mode === 'menu';
  const { mounted, state, ref: panelRef } = usePresence<HTMLDivElement>(open);

  const setSlotRef = useCallback((el: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
    slotRef.current = el;
    setSlot(el);
  }, []);

  const close = useCallback(() => {
    intent.cancel();
    from.current = null;
    setDirection(null);
    setValue('');
  }, [intent, setValue]);

  const select = useCallback<NavigationMenuContextValue['select']>(
    (next, how) => {
      intent.cancel();
      const current = valueRef.current;
      if (next === current) return;
      if (!next) {
        close();
        return;
      }
      if (modeRef.current === 'menu' && current && surfaceRef.current) {
        // Moving between items: remember the panel's box and which way we travel
        const s = surfaceRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const c = caretRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
        from.current = {
          left: s.left,
          top: s.top,
          width: s.width,
          height: s.height,
          caretX: c ? c.left + c.width / 2 : s.left + s.width / 2,
        };
        const a = triggers.current.get(current)?.getBoundingClientRect();
        const b = triggers.current.get(next)?.getBoundingClientRect();
        setDirection(a && b ? (b.left > a.left ? 'end' : 'start') : null);
      } else {
        from.current = null;
        setDirection(null);
      }
      hoverOpened.current = how === 'hover';
      setValue(next);
    },
    [intent, close, setValue],
  );

  const hoverIn = useCallback(
    (next: string) => {
      if (modeRef.current !== 'menu') return;
      // Already browsing the bar: switch at once. Otherwise wait for intent.
      intent.start(() => select(next, 'hover'), valueRef.current ? 0 : openDelay);
    },
    [intent, select, openDelay],
  );

  const hoverElsewhere = useCallback(() => {
    intent.cancel();
    if (valueRef.current) intent.start(close, 150);
  }, [intent, close]);

  const focusContent = useCallback(() => {
    slotRef.current
      ?.querySelector('.ui-nav-menu-content[data-state="open"]')
      ?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)
      ?.focus();
  }, []);

  /** Centre the panel under the active trigger (kept inside the viewport) and aim the caret. */
  const place = useCallback((): Geometry | null => {
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    const surface = surfaceRef.current;
    const slotEl = slotRef.current;
    const trigger = triggers.current.get(valueRef.current || lastValue.current);
    if (!panel || !surface || !slotEl || !trigger) return null;
    const t = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    // The slot is the content's natural size, independent of the surface's animated size
    const width = slotEl.offsetWidth + (surface.offsetWidth - surface.clientWidth);
    const height = slotEl.offsetHeight + (surface.offsetHeight - surface.clientHeight);
    const viewport = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    const centre = t.left + t.width / 2;
    const left = Math.round(Math.max(8, Math.min(centre - width / 2, viewport - width - 8)));
    const top = Math.round(t.bottom + 12);
    const caret = Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(centre - left, 20), Math.max(20, width - 20)));
    panel.style.left = `${left}px`;
    panel.style.top = `${top}px`;
    panel.style.setProperty('--ui-nav-caret-x', `${caret}px`);
    panel.style.setProperty('--ui-origin', `${caret}px 0px`);
    return { left, top, width, height, caretX: left + caret };
  }, [panelRef]);

  // Show the panel in the top layer, place it, and glide from the previous item's box
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (!panel) return;
    if (supportsPopover && !panel.matches(':popover-open')) {
      try {
        panel.showPopover();
      } catch {
        /* already open or detached */
      }
    }
    for (const a of animations.current) a.cancel();
    animations.current = [];
    const geo = place();
    const start = from.current;
    from.current = null;
    const surface = surfaceRef.current;
    const caret = caretRef.current;
    if (!geo || !start || !surface || !caret || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    try {
      const easing = cssVar('--ui-spring-smooth') || 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';
      const duration = parseFloat(cssVar('--ui-spring-smooth-duration')) || 540;
      const timing = { duration, easing };
      const dx = start.left - geo.left;
      const dy = start.top - geo.top;
      animations.current = [
        panel.animate({ translate: [`${dx}px ${dy}px`, '0px 0px'] }, timing),
        surface.animate(
          { width: [`${start.width}px`, `${geo.width}px`], height: [`${start.height}px`, `${geo.height}px`] },
          timing,
        ),
        caret.animate({ translate: [`${start.caretX - geo.caretX - dx}px 0px`, '0px 0px'] }, timing),
      ];
    } catch {
      /* unsupported easing or property: the content still slides */
    }
  }, [open, value, slot, place, panelRef]);

  // Follow resize, scroll and content size changes while open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let raf = 0;
    const schedule = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(place);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', schedule);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', schedule, true);
    const ro = typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' ? new ResizeObserver(schedule) : null;
    if (slot) ro?.observe(slot);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', schedule);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', schedule, true);
      ro?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [open, slot, place]);

  useDismiss(value !== '', [rootRef, panelRef], (reason) => {
    const last = lastValue.current;
    close();
    if (reason === 'escape') triggers.current.get(last)?.focus();
  });

  const rovePanel = useRovingFocus({
    itemSelector: 'a[href], button:not(:disabled)',
    orientation: 'both',
    loop: false,
    typeahead: false,
  });

  const ctx: NavigationMenuContextValue = {
    value,
    lastValue: lastValue.current,
    mode,
    slot,
    direction,
    triggers,
    focusOnOpen,
    hoverOpened,
    select,
    close,
    focusContent,
    hoverIn,
    hoverElsewhere,
  };

  return (
    <NavigationMenuContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <nav
        ref={ref}
        aria-label="Site menu"
        {...props}
        data-mode={mode}
        className={cn('ui-nav-menu', className)}
        onPointerEnter={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
          onPointerEnter?.(e);
          if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') intent.cancel();
        }}
        onPointerLeave={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
          onPointerLeave?.(e);
          if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || modeRef.current !== 'menu') return;
          if (valueRef.current) intent.start(close, closeDelay);
          else intent.cancel();
        }}
        onBlur={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
          onBlur?.(e);
          if (modeRef.current !== 'menu' || !valueRef.current) return;
          const next = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
          if (next && !e.currentTarget.contains(next)) close();
        }}
      >
        {children}
        {mode === 'menu' && mounted && (
          <div
            ref={panelRef}
            popover="manual"
            data-state={state}
            data-side="bottom"
            className="ui-floating ui-nav-menu-panel"
            onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
              if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                // Up from the first link goes back to the trigger
                const first = e.currentTarget.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE);
                if (first && document.activeElement === first) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  triggers.current.get(valueRef.current)?.focus();
                  return;
                }
              }
              rovePanel(e);
            }}
          >
            <div ref={surfaceRef} className="ui-nav-menu-surface">
              <div ref={setSlotRef} className="ui-nav-menu-slot" />
            </div>
            <span ref={caretRef} className="ui-nav-menu-caret" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
        )}
      </nav>
    </NavigationMenuContext.Provider>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-hover-intent.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * One cancellable timer for hover intent (tooltip delays, submenu open/close).
 * Starting a new timer replaces the previous one; it is cleared on unmount.
 *   const intent = useHoverIntent();
 *   intent.start(() => setOpen(true), 700);   intent.cancel();
 */
export function useHoverIntent() {
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
  }, []);

  const start = useCallback(
    (fn: () => void, delay: number) => {
      cancel();
      if (delay <= 0) {
        fn();
        return;
      }
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        timer.current = undefined;
        fn();
      }, delay);
    },
    [cancel],
  );

  useEffect(() => cancel, [cancel]);

  return useMemo(() => ({ start, cancel }), [start, cancel]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-presence.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { animationsFinished } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Keeps an element mounted until its exit animation has finished.
 *   const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence(open);
 *   {mounted && <div ref={ref} data-state={state} />}
 * CSS animates on [data-state="open" | "closed"]; nothing else is needed.
 */
export function usePresence<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(present: boolean) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(present);
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (present) {
      setMounted(true);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(ref.current).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setMounted(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [present]);

  return {
    mounted: present || mounted,
    state: (present ? 'open' : 'closed') as 'open' | 'closed',
    ref,
  };
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/slot.tsx`

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Children,
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/navigation-menu.css`

```css
/* Navigation menu ---------------------------------------------------------
   <nav class="ui-nav-menu" data-mode="menu|accordion">
     <ul class="ui-nav-menu-list">
       <li class="ui-nav-menu-item">
         <button class="ui-nav-menu-trigger" data-state aria-expanded> label + chevron
         (content is portaled into the shared panel below, or sits in .ui-nav-menu-accordion)
       <li class="ui-nav-menu-item"><a class="ui-nav-menu-link">
     <div class="ui-floating ui-nav-menu-panel" popover="manual" data-state>     ONE panel, top layer
       <div class="ui-nav-menu-surface">                                          the visible box (JS animates its size)
         <div class="ui-nav-menu-slot">
           <div class="ui-nav-menu-content" data-state data-motion="from-start|from-end|to-start|to-end">
       <span class="ui-nav-menu-caret">                                           glides under the trigger
   JS writes left/top and --ui-nav-caret-x on the panel; when the open item
   changes it animates the panel's `translate`, the surface's width/height and
   the caret's `translate` from the previous box on the smooth spring.
   Rich links: .ui-nav-menu-link[data-in-content] > .ui-nav-menu-link-title + -description
   Layout helper: .ui-nav-menu-grid (--ui-nav-cols, --ui-nav-width).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@keyframes ui-nav-in-end { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(28px); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); } }
@keyframes ui-nav-in-start { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-28px); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); } }
@keyframes ui-nav-out-start { to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-28px); } }
@keyframes ui-nav-out-end { to { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(28px); } }

@layer components {
  .ui-nav-menu { position: relative; }
  .ui-nav-menu-list { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  .ui-nav-menu-item { position: relative; min-width: 0; }

  /* ---- bar: triggers and plain links ---- */
  .ui-nav-menu-trigger,
  .ui-nav-menu-link:not([data-in-content]) {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    height: 2.25rem;
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-trigger[data-state="open"],
  .ui-nav-menu-link:not([data-in-content])[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-nav-menu-trigger[data-state="open"] { background: var(--ui-accent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-nav-menu-trigger:hover,
    .ui-nav-menu-link:not([data-in-content]):hover { color: var(--ui-foreground); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent) 70%, transparent); }
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-trigger:focus-visible,
  .ui-nav-menu-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-nav-menu-chevron { flex: none; transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy); }
  .ui-nav-menu-trigger[data-state="open"] .ui-nav-menu-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

  /* ---- the shared panel ---- */
  .ui-nav-menu-panel { width: max-content; max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem); }
  .ui-nav-menu-panel[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-nav-menu-panel[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-nav-menu-surface {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-slot { position: relative; width: max-content; max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem - 2px); }
  .ui-nav-menu-content { padding: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-nav-menu-content[data-motion="from-end"] { animation: ui-nav-in-end var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-nav-menu-content[data-motion="from-start"] { animation: ui-nav-in-start var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  /* the item being left: lifted out of the flow so the panel sizes to the new one */
  .ui-nav-menu-content[data-state="closed"][data-motion^="to-"] { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-nav-menu-content[data-motion="to-start"] { animation: ui-nav-out-start var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; }
  .ui-nav-menu-content[data-motion="to-end"] { animation: ui-nav-out-end var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; }

  .ui-nav-menu-caret {
    position: absolute;
    top: -5px;
    left: var(--ui-nav-caret-x, 50%);
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-left: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-top-left-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ---- panel links ---- */
  .ui-nav-menu-link[data-in-content] {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-nav-menu-link[data-in-content]:hover { background: var(--ui-accent); }
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-link[data-in-content][aria-current="page"] { background: var(--ui-accent); }
  .ui-nav-menu-link-title { font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; }
  .ui-nav-menu-link-description { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.125rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  .ui-nav-menu-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--ui-nav-cols, 1), minmax(0, 1fr));
    width: var(--ui-nav-width, 22rem);
    max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
  }

  /* ---- accordion fallback ---- */
  .ui-nav-menu[data-mode="accordion"] .ui-nav-menu-list { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.125rem; }
  .ui-nav-menu[data-mode="accordion"] .ui-nav-menu-trigger,
  .ui-nav-menu[data-mode="accordion"] .ui-nav-menu-link:not([data-in-content]) {
    width: 100%;
    height: 2.75rem;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: var(--text-md);
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-accordion {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: 0fr;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: grid-template-rows var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      visibility 0s linear var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration);
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-accordion[data-state="open"] {
    grid-template-rows: 1fr;
    visibility: visible;
    transition: grid-template-rows var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth), visibility 0s;
  }
  .ui-nav-menu-accordion-inner { min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .ui-nav-menu[data-mode="accordion"] .ui-nav-menu-content { padding: 0.125rem 0 0.5rem 0.75rem; }
  .ui-nav-menu[data-mode="accordion"] .ui-nav-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); width: 100%; max-width: none; }
}
```

## Usage

**Products and resources** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/navigation-menu/products.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import type { CSSProperties, MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuLinkDescription, NavigationMenuLinkTitle, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuTrigger } from '@/ui/components/navigation-menu';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const products: { title: string; description: string; icon: IconName }[] = [
  { title: 'Analytics', description: 'Dashboards your whole team understands.', icon: 'bar-chart' },
  { title: 'Automations', description: 'Trigger workflows from any event.', icon: 'zap' },
  { title: 'Collaboration', description: 'Comment, assign and review in one place.', icon: 'users' },
  { title: 'Security', description: 'SSO, audit logs and role-based access.', icon: 'lock' },
];
const resources = [
  { title: 'Documentation', description: 'Guides and API reference.' },
  { title: 'Changelog', description: 'What shipped this week.' },
  { title: 'Community', description: '12,000 builders on Discord.' },
];

const stop = (e: MouseEvent) => e.preventDefault();

export default function NavigationMenuProducts() {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-[22rem] justify-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-background p-3 pt-4">
      <NavigationMenu aria-label="Site">
        <NavigationMenuList>
          <NavigationMenuItem value="products">
            <NavigationMenuTrigger>Products</NavigationMenuTrigger>
            <NavigationMenuContent>
              <div className="ui-nav-menu-grid" style={{ '--ui-nav-cols': 2, '--ui-nav-width': '35rem' } as CSSProperties}>
                {products.map(({ title, description, icon }) => (
                  <NavigationMenuLink key={title} href="#" onClick={stop}>
                    <span className="mb-1 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground">
                      <Icon name={icon} size={16} />
                    </span>
                    <NavigationMenuLinkTitle>{title}</NavigationMenuLinkTitle>
                    <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>{description}</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
                  </NavigationMenuLink>
                ))}
              </div>
            </NavigationMenuContent>
          </NavigationMenuItem>

          <NavigationMenuItem value="resources">
            <NavigationMenuTrigger>Resources</NavigationMenuTrigger>
            <NavigationMenuContent>
              <div className="ui-nav-menu-grid" style={{ '--ui-nav-width': '19rem' } as CSSProperties}>
                {resources.map(({ title, description }) => (
                  <NavigationMenuLink key={title} href="#" onClick={stop}>
                    <NavigationMenuLinkTitle>{title}</NavigationMenuLinkTitle>
                    <NavigationMenuLinkDescription>{description}</NavigationMenuLinkDescription>
                  </NavigationMenuLink>
                ))}
              </div>
            </NavigationMenuContent>
          </NavigationMenuItem>

          <NavigationMenuItem>
            <NavigationMenuLink href="#" onClick={stop}>
              Pricing
            </NavigationMenuLink>
          </NavigationMenuItem>
        </NavigationMenuList>
      </NavigationMenu>
    </div>
  );
}
```
